How it works

Follow your deposit from the first transfer to the first payout.

From deposit to payout

  1. Open your wallet

    On the Deposit tab, choose a supported coin and network and enter a USD amount.

  2. Send crypto and submit your hash

    Use the quoted amount, address and network. The cashier reviews your transfer before crediting your USD balance.

  3. Choose a plan and invest

    On Plans, choose Invest and enter an amount within the plan’s limits. Your first daily credit unlocks at the next midnight UTC.

  4. Request a withdrawal

    Open the wallet’s Withdraw tab and enter your receiving address. View the status and all your account history in Profile.
